'''Notori''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of unknown [[Ajah]], and secretly part of the [[Black Ajah]]. 

==Activities==
She took part in the [[Battle in Tel'aran'rhiod|Battle in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'']] and was killed by a blast of [[Fire]] created by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]. Because she was killed in the World of Dreams, she also died in the waking world.

She was probably using a dream ''[[ter'angreal]]'', otherwise her soul would be obliterated from the [[Pattern]].
